t: Mike Levin's Blueprint for Durable Computing Sovereignty & AIE
s: Mike Levin outlines his journey towards computing sovereignty, proposing AIE (AI Education) as the successor to SEO. He champions NixOS and HTMX for creating durable, AI-ergonomic systems, exemplified by his Pipulate project.
sub: AIE (AI Education) as the future field replacing SEO, focusing on mutual AI-human learning.
NixOS and HTMX as core technologies for durable, reproducible, and AI-ergonomic computing environments.
Pipulate: A project leveraging these technologies for complex SEO deliverable generation.
Mike Levin's historical contributions (HitTail, Levinux) and their relevance to his current work.
